clips.linkedin:
Your AI can track which brands ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Claude cite for your 20 key buyer questions.

The CMA has proposed that Google show UK Android and Chrome users a choice of search service every year, with AI assistants eligible if they credit and link to their sources. The CMA's own research points to a slow drift rather than a rush, but every switcher who asks a question sends a visit to the page the assistant quotes.

So it's worth knowing where you stand now. Give your AI your product range and your sales team's common questions. It drafts the 20 questions that matter most commercially and builds a table of who each assistant cites and links to, and whether you're one of them.

Re-run it each quarter.

The podcast voices are AI-generated. Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/cma-google-choice-screen-ai-assistants/
clips.text: Get AI on this. First job? Get AI on your citation baseline. Your twenty most commercially important buyer questions, and which brands the assistants cite for each. Give it your product range and your sales team's common questions, and it drafts the twenty and builds the tracking table. Where it can browse it runs them itself. Where it can't reach an assistant, someone pastes the answers in and it logs who's cited and linked, and whether you're one of them.
